Background

About Me

Muhammad Usama is a business professional and community leader based in Islamabad, Pakistan. He is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) at the International Islamic University Islamabad (IIUI), Faculty of Management Sciences.

He serves as Chapter President of the Young Peace and Development Corps (YPDC) at IIUI, leading peace-building workshops, leadership programs, and community development initiatives for university students.

Alongside his studies and leadership role, Usama works as Training Manager at Cheezious, overseeing staff development, operational standards, and team performance — building on 4+ years of hands-on hospitality experience.
